alerts.title: Creatinine monitoring overdue while on TDF
alerts.message: Creatinine last recorded 478 days ago for a patient on TDF. Consider ordering repeat renal function monitoring.
alerts.query_hint: TDF renal function monitoring creatinine schedule

alerts.title: Creatinine not monitored for over 12 months
alerts.message: Patient on TDF + DTG has no creatinine result in 478 days. TDF is nephrotoxic and DTG inhibits renal creatinine secretion, making periodic renal monitoring essential. The last creatinine (88 umol/L) was normal, but no recent trend can be assessed. The clinician's plan includes no renal monitoring orders today.

evidence.recommended_action: Order serum creatinine and eGFR at this visit to assess renal function given TDF-containing regimen.

alerts.title: Viral load 40 copies/mL — borderline detectable
alerts.message: Guidelines state VL < 50 copies/mL should continue regimen, while VL > 50 requires enhanced adherence support and repeat VL in 2-3 months. Patient's VL of 40 copies/mL falls below the 50 threshold, so continuation is appropriate. However, being near the cutoff warrants confirmation of adherence and timely repeat testing per 6-monthly monitoring schedule.

evidence.recommended_action: Continue current regimen. Confirm adherence and schedule next VL in 6 months per monitoring guidelines.
